purpose: Determine whether the bounded 2-D endpoint-pair log-ratio representation converges sufficiently rapidly under globally increased asinh-axis density, after the 49x49 anchored candidate failed the off-grid C3b holdout.
candidate_family_frozen: asinh endpoint-pair bilinear log(K_DAR/K_MFP) with the same signed pressure-head decade anchors and exact equal-head reconciliation
probe_set: reuse the now-revealed C3b off-grid set only for convergence characterization
methodological_rule: Because C3b has now been observed, no density selected from C4 may be called qualified on C3b. Any promoted density requires a newly precommitted independent C4b holdout with a different deterministic seed and off-grid endpoint family.
metrics: table values and bytes per material-half-face class

decision_interpretation.rapid_monotone_convergence_at_bounded_me: representation family remains viable; choose the smallest defensible density only as a candidate and send it to new C4b holdout
decision_interpretation.slow_or_nonmonotone_convergence_or_exces: do not continue brute-force 2-D density escalation; investigate a different coordinate/representation such as transformed flux structure, low-rank/separable representation, local analytic face solve, or restrict the hydraulic envelope
